nodes.question: How does the national government in the Netherlands collaborate with regions to develop charging infrastructure strategies?
nodes.answer: The national government in the Netherlands has a national strategy for charging infrastructure and collaborates with bigger regions to develop their regional charging strategies. They also assist cities in creating and implementing their strategies.
